visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens outdoors in a coastal village with a man standing before a traditional stone-walled structure. He is shirtless, wearing a traditional white and patterned loincloth and a distinctive beaded necklace. He wears a black baseball cap. His facial expressions are animated as he gestures broadly with his tanned arms toward the surroundings. The background features lush green hills and wooden huts under natural daylight. (2) The camera transitions indoors to a dimly lit, narrow subterranean wooden dwelling. The man is seen kneeling and crawling through the tight space, demonstrating the various levels of the house. He uses his hands to point at the dark wooden floors and walls. The lighting is low, casting deep shadows, but a portable fan is visible on the floor, providing a modern contrast to the traditional setting. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the man as he sits cross-legged inside the wooden house. He is holding a yellow and blue 'Hahatai' microphone. His expressions are earnest and lively as he speaks, frequently using hand gestures to emphasize his points. The wooden interior is weathered and dark, with various hanging items and structural beams visible in the background. (4) The scene cuts to a young woman with long dark hair and bangs, standing against a plain dark background. She is wearing a black top and multiple necklaces, holding a white stylus. She speaks directly to the camera with a friendly and informative expression. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting her face and upper body. (5) Returning to the man inside the traditional house, he points out a large, black woven basket with a lid and ropes. He gestures toward the basket with his hands and a piece of wood, explaining its significance. An interviewer's hand holding the microphone is visible. The man continues his storytelling with a mischievous yet serious expression, occasionally laughing. The setting remains the dark, atmospheric wooden interior.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @hahatai_official. [Slogan]: 蘭嶼. [Subtitle]: 薩克斯風王子還有另一個身分. (2) [Subtitle]: 地下屋導覽員. (3) [Subtitle]: 王子邀請我們前往他的地下屋參觀. (4) [Subtitle]: 我們這個傳統地下屋的第一層 就是我們吃飯的餐廳. (5) [Subtitle]: 第二層 睡覺跟廚房. (6) [Subtitle]: 第三層 倉庫跟燻飛魚乾的地方 我們是步步高升的. (7) [Subtitle]: 這個飛魚季很多禁忌的 女孩子是不可以碰船摸船的. (8) [Subtitle]: 夫妻之間是不可以行房的 不過偷偷的還是有啦. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以很多做父母親的呢 嬰兒滿一個月滿兩個月才去報戶口 為了不要讓他的小孩. (10) [Subtitle]: 被人家欺負的 不能講一月二月的. (11) [Variety]: 可是如果一二月會怎麼樣. (12) [Subtitle]: 一二月就代表是在飛魚季 對在做的 帶來不吉利的. (13) [Subtitle]: 在蘭嶼的牡羊座和金牛座的朋友 請先查明自己的出生日期再參考運勢. (14) [Subtitle]: 這邊有沒有黑色圓圓有繩子的 這個相當於你們台灣的保險箱. (15) [Variety]: 可是他看起來超不保險的!!. (16) [Subtitle]: 對你這樣聽下去就知道了 這個裡面只能藏一些比較貴重的幾樣東西. (17) [Subtitle]: 那就是銀盔銀帽 還有黃金 瑪瑙 Ma La po nigt (玉珮類的東西). (18) [Subtitle]: 新的丁字褲都裝在這個裡面 別人呢 是不可能來我家偷保險箱裡面的東西. (19) [Subtitle]: 我們也不可能去那邊偷 因為我們會唸這個咒語 偷他裡面的東西. (20) [Variety]: 會不得好死. (21) [Subtitle]: 大家都不敢嘗試了. [Variety]: 你們用的是魔法攻擊. (22) [Subtitle]: 對對對 大家都不敢嘗試. [Variety]: 點滿物理防禦也抵擋不了雅美族(達悟族)的魔法攻擊.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To introduce the traditional underground housing and cultural taboos of the Tao people on Lanyu in a fun and accessible street-interview format. The video aims to educate viewers about indigenous culture while maintaining a humorous and engaging tone typical of 'Hahatai' content.
